name: Garden of Apeiron
description: A vast uncanny region at the edge of the system where the Inspirit drifts.

description_citations.work: The Legends of Edge of Eternities
description_citations.text: "The Legends of Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Amanda LaFranco, Laurel Pratt, Jay Annelli. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Jul 2025.

timeline.summary: Kilo self-actualizes and takes a mechan body aboard the Inspirit in the Garden of Apeiron.
timeline.quote: Kilo has fully self-actualized, naming itself and moving the primary sliver of its consciousness to a single mechan body aboard its host vessel.

pages_say.description: An uncharted anomalous region between the Wurmwall and Uthros that swallows ships and appears to be moving toward Sothera.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Edge of Eternities" by Miguel Lopez, Jay Annelli, Laurel Pratt, Amanda LaFranco. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2025.

pages_say.description: A region where cosmic gas collides and heats before the Wurmwall; Tannuk once worked search and rescue from a station there.

citation.text: "Edge of Eternities | Episode 11" by Seth Dickinson. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jul 2025.
